raw_translation: Ang mga rate na ipinapakita ay nalalapat lamang sa ZXQPH0000QXZ–ZXQPH0001QXZ Australian income year (ZXQPH0002QXZ Hulyo ZXQPH0003QXZ hanggang ZXQPH0004QXZ Hunyo ZXQPH0005QXZ). Ang Medicare levy at surcharge, deductions, offsets, HELP repayments, withholding, special income at mga kaso ng kumplikadong paninirahan ay hindi kasama. Kumpirmahin ang iyong mga pangyayari sa Australian Taxation Office. Ang kalkulador ay di-nagbabago matapos ang taon ng buwis hanggang sa suriin ang mga rate nito.
source: Rates shown apply only to the 2026–27 Australian income year (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027). Medicare levy and surcharge, deductions, offsets, HELP repayments, withholding, special income and complex residency cases are excluded. Confirm your circumstances with the Australian Taxation Office. The calculator disables itself after the tax year ends until its rates are reviewed.
translation: Ang mga rate na ipinapakita ay nalalapat lamang sa 2026–27 Australian income year (1 Hulyo 2026 hanggang 30 Hunyo 2027).
